# YouTube Channel Video Catalog & Profile Scraper

Point this actor at a YouTube channel and get its full public catalog back — the latest uploads, the complete back-catalog, Shorts, live and upcoming streams, playlists, podcast shows and channel courses — with exact view and like counts, publish dates, durations and descriptions, plus the channel profile: subscribers, description, links, country, join date, total views and verification.

## What this actor does

- **Complete video catalog:** newest, most popular or oldest first, paged through the channel's entire upload list
- **Exact per-video metrics:** exact view count, exact like count, publish date, exact duration, description and category (when YouTube makes it publicly visible)
- **Every public surface:** Shorts (with its own sort), live/upcoming/past streams, playlists, podcast shows, courses and music releases
- **Channel profile:** subscribers, video count, handle, description, avatar, banner, country, join date, total views, external links, verification, keywords
- **Members-only listings:** optionally list members-only videos (titles and public metadata) when YouTube offers that filter for the channel
- **Bulk channels:** paste URLs, handles (`@name`) or channel IDs, one per line
- **Empty fields are omitted** — empty text and missing numbers are left out instead of emitted as `null`

## Output per video row

Each long-form video is one row. Optional scalar fields are omitted when YouTube does not expose a value.

| Field | Type | Example |
|-------|------|---------|
| `videoId` | string | `"0e3GPea1Tyg"` |
| `title` | string | `"$456,000 Squid Game In Real Life!"` |
| `url` | string | `"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0e3GPea1Tyg"` |
| `viewCount` | integer (optional; exact only) | `905688793` |
| `viewCountText` | string (optional) | `"905,688,793 views"` |
| `likeCount` | integer (optional; exact only) | `2009889` |
| `publishedAt` | string (optional) | `"2026-10-03"` or `"2026-10-03T09:00:01-07:00"` |
| `category` | string (optional) | `"Entertainment"` |
| `publishedTimeText` | string (optional) | `"2 days ago"` |
| `duration` | string (optional; may be `"LIVE"`) | `"25:42"` |
| `durationSeconds` | integer (optional) | `1542` |
| `thumbnailUrl` | string (optional) | Video thumbnail URL |
| `description` | string (optional) | Video description |
| `isLive` | boolean | `false` |
| `isShort` | boolean | `false` |
| `isUpcoming` | boolean (only when true) | `true` |
| `isMembersOnly` | boolean (only when true) | `true` |
| `concurrentViewersText` | string (live only) | `"2K watching"` |
| `badges` | array (optional) | Card badges such as `"New"` or `"4K"` |
| `authorMetadata` | object | Channel details (see below) |
| `scrapedAt` | string | `"2026-10-18T12:00:00+00:00"` |

If `includeExactMetrics` is off, `viewCount`/`likeCount`/`publishedAt`/`category` are omitted and the listing-page values (`viewCountText`, `publishedTimeText`) are returned instead. `category` and exact like counts are omitted when YouTube does not make them publicly visible.

### Surface arrays

`shorts`, `playlists`, `liveVideos`, `podcasts`, `courses` and `releases` are attached to the first video row of each channel (or to the channel-only row when `maxVideos` is 0) and are never repeated on every row.

- `shorts[]` — `videoId`, `title`, `viewCountText`, `url`, `thumbnailUrl`, `type: "short"`; exact metrics are added when `includeExactMetrics` is on
- `playlists[]` — `playlistId`, `title`, `url`, `thumbnailUrl`, `videoCountText`, `videoCount`, `lastUpdatedText`
- `liveVideos[]` — the same video fields as a normal row, including `isLive`, `isUpcoming` and `concurrentViewersText`
- `podcasts[]` — `podcastShowId`, `title`, `url`, `thumbnailUrl`, `episodeCountText`, `episodeCount`, `lastUpdatedText`
- `courses[]` / `releases[]` — `playlistId`, `title`, `url`, `thumbnailUrl`, `videoCountText`, `videoCount`

### `authorMetadata` fields

| Field | Type | Example |
|-------|------|---------|
| `channelId` | string | `"UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuVA"` |
| `channelName` | string | `"MrBeast"` |
| `handle` | string | `"@MrBeast"` |
| `channelUrl` | string | `"https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast"` |
| `description` | string | Channel description |
| `subscriberCountText` | string | `"466M subscribers"` |
| `subscriberCount` | integer (optional; exact text only) | `8390` |
| `videoCount` / `videoCountText` | integer / string | `948` / `"948 videos"` |
| `country` | string (optional, ISO code) | `"CZ"` |
| `location` | string (optional) | `"Czechia"` |
| `joinedDateText` | string (optional) | `"Joined Feb 20, 2012"` |
| `totalViews` / `totalViewsText` | integer / string (optional) | `2424926` / `"2,424,926 views"` |
| `externalLinks[]` | array (optional) | `[{"title": "Website", "url": "https://..."}]` |
| `aboutDescription` | string (optional) | Description as shown on the About panel |
| `avatarUrl`, `bannerUrl` | string | Image URLs |
| `isVerified`, `isFamilySafe` | boolean | `true` |
| `isOfficialArtistChannel` | boolean (only when true) | `true` |
| `keywords` | array (optional) | Owner-set channel keywords |
| `channelLinks[]` | array (optional) | Header links: `[{"title": "...", "url": "..."}]` |
| `rssUrl` | string (optional) | The channel's upstream RSS URL (YouTube's feed availability varies) |

Numeric profile counts are emitted only when YouTube supplies an unabridged integer (for example `1,234 subscribers`). Rounded labels such as `466M subscribers` stay in the matching `*Text` field; an approximate value is never presented as an exact count.

If a channel page cannot be fetched or parsed at all, a row with `channelUrl`, `error`, `success: false` and `scrapedAt` is returned instead.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `channelUrls` | string[] | Yes | – | Channel URLs, `@handles` or channel IDs |
| `maxVideos` | integer | No | 50 | Max long-form videos per channel (0–10000). 0 returns profile only |
| `sortVideosBy` | string | No | `"newest"` | `newest`, `popular`, `oldest` (falls back to newest when unavailable) |
| `sortShortsBy` | string | No | `"newest"` | Shorts sort: `newest`, `popular`, `oldest` |
| `includeAbout` | boolean | No | true | About-panel fields: total views, join date, location, country, links |
| `includeShorts` | boolean | No | false | Include the Shorts tab |
| `maxShorts` | integer | No | 20 | Cap for Shorts (1–2000) |
| `includeLiveVideos` | boolean | No | false | Include live, upcoming and past streams |
| `maxLiveVideos` | integer | No | 20 | Cap for streams (1–500) |
| `includePlaylists` | boolean | No | false | Include playlists |
| `maxPlaylists` | integer | No | 20 | Cap for playlists (1–500) |
| `includePodcasts` | boolean | No | false | Include podcast shows |
| `maxPodcasts` | integer | No | 50 | Cap for podcast shows (1–500) |
| `includeCourses` | boolean | No | false | Include courses |
| `maxCourses` | integer | No | 50 | Cap for courses (1–500) |
| `includeReleases` | boolean | No | false | Include music releases |
| `maxReleases` | integer | No | 50 | Cap for releases (1–500) |
| `includeMembersOnly` | boolean | No | false | Also list members-only videos when YouTube offers that filter |
| `includeExactMetrics` | boolean | No | true | Also fetch each video's exact counts, dates and descriptions (slower; turn off for listing-page values only) |
| `market` | string | No | `"US"` | Market/region for content availability (31 countries) |
| `language` | string | No | `"en"` | Language for YouTube's interface text (relative dates) |

### Supported channel formats

- `@MrBeast` — handle
- `https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast` — full URL
- `https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuVA` — channel ID URL
- `UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuVA` — raw channel ID
- `MrBeast` — plain name (treated as a handle)

### Example: catalog with every surface

```json
{
  "channelUrls": ["@MrBeast"],
  "maxVideos": 100,
  "sortVideosBy": "popular",
  "includeShorts": true,
  "maxShorts": 50,
  "includeLiveVideos": true,
  "includePlaylists": true
}
```

### Example: profile-only enrichment for a lead list

```json
{
  "channelUrls": ["@MrBeast", "@mkbhd", "@kurzgesagt"],
  "maxVideos": 0,
  "includeAbout": true
}
```

### Example: podcast and course discovery

```json
{
  "channelUrls": ["@LofiGirl", "@Fireship"],
  "maxVideos": 10,
  "includePodcasts": true,
  "includeCourses": true,
  "includeReleases": true
}
```

### Example: members-only backlog

```json
{
  "channelUrls": ["@LinusTechTips"],
  "maxVideos": 50,
  "includeMembersOnly": true
}
```

## Use cases

- **Channel research** — map a creator's complete output, posting cadence and growth metrics
- **Competitor analysis** — compare catalogs, view/like counts and publishing frequency across a niche
- **Content auditing** — inventory every video on a channel to find gaps and evergreen performers
- **Influencer vetting** — subscriber counts, verification, country and engagement signals in one run
- **Media monitoring** — track news and live channels, including upcoming broadcasts
- **ML datasets** — exact counts, ISO dates and descriptions ready for analysis

## FAQ

**Do I need a YouTube API key?**
No. The actor reads public YouTube pages and YouTube's own web endpoints; no API key, login or cookie is required.

**Which sort orders are available?**
Newest, most popular and oldest — for both long-form videos and Shorts. If a channel does not offer a chosen order, newest-first is used and the run log says so.

**Why are some counts exact and others text only?**
YouTube shows rounded labels like `466M subscribers` on channel pages. The actor keeps that label in its `*Text` field and never expands it into a fake exact number. Exact `viewCount` and `likeCount` come from each video's own metadata.

**What does `includeExactMetrics` do?**
It fetches each video's exact views, likes, publish date, category and description. Turning it off makes runs faster and cheaper but returns listing-page values only.

**How far back does the catalog go?**
The actor pages through the channel's entire upload list, up to your `maxVideos` setting (maximum 10,000 per channel). Channels with tens of thousands of uploads are limited only by that cap.

**What can I learn about members-only or age-restricted videos?**
Titles, publish dates, durations and like counts are public for members-only videos when the channel shows them in its Members-only filter — those rows carry `isMembersOnly: true` and are added in addition to your `maxVideos` setting. Age-restricted videos are listed like any other video, with their public title, views, likes and duration; only *playback* is age-gated. Members-only and age-gated playback still requires a logged-in session; the actor never logs in.

**Are live streams included?**
Yes, with `includeLiveVideos`: active streams include `isLive` and a `concurrentViewersText` (for example `"2K watching"`), scheduled premieres carry `isUpcoming`, and past streams come back with durations.

**How fresh is the data?**
Data is fetched live at run time — there is no cache. Every run reflects the channel's current state. If a channel's catalog page cannot be fetched at all, the actor falls back to YouTube's public channel feed and returns that channel's latest 15 uploads instead of an empty result.

**Do I need to set up a proxy?**
No. The actor uses a working public connection to YouTube automatically. Just fill in the input and run it.

**Is this affiliated with YouTube?**
No. This is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by YouTube or Google.
